name: @kedi-lang/pi-bridge
description: A Kedi JSON-RPC bridge for the pi coding agent

scripts.build: esbuild bridge.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --minify-whitespace --minify-syntax --legal-comments=none --metafile=dist/meta.json --outfile=dist/bridge.mjs "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __kediRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __kediRequire(import.meta.url);" && node scripts/notices.ts dist/meta.json > dist/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt
